login.title: Sign in to Stringherd
login.subtitle: Review machine translations before they ship.

errors.network: Can't reach the Stringherd server. Check that it's running.

projects.title: Your projects
projects.emptyReviewer: No languages assigned to you yet. Ask an admin to assign you a project and language.
projects.emptyAdmin: No projects yet. Create one in <projects>Projects</projects>, then push translations with DeepL Sync.

statusHint.delivered: Delivered: pulled into the code, and locked

review.emptyNone: This language has no strings yet.
review.saveFailed: Couldn't save {{key}}. The change was undone; try again.
review.notAssigned: You aren't assigned to review this language.
review.summary: {{total, number}} strings · {{toReview, number}} to review · {{approved, number}} approved · {{delivered, number}} delivered
review.hints: Ctrl+Enter approve and next · Alt+↑ Alt+↓ move · Esc discard or close

qa.title: Quality checks
qa.sameAsSource: Same as the source text. Fine for names and codes; otherwise translate it.
qa.outerSpaces: Spaces at the start or end differ from the source.
qa.endPunctuation: Ending punctuation differs from the source.

context.noScreenshot: No screenshot for this string yet.
context.inCodeHint: Reopened: the code keeps this text until the next Deliver.

review.selectString: Choose a string from the list.
review.hintsSingle: Ctrl+Enter approve and next · Alt+↑ Alt+↓ move · Esc discard

deliver.nothing: Approve strings first; Deliver sends the approved ones.
deliver.title: Deliver {{language}}?
deliver.body_one: {{count, number}} approved string goes to the repository: the next deepl sync pull brings it into the code. It leaves your list and is locked.
deliver.body_other: {{count, number}} approved strings go to the repository: the next deepl sync pull brings them into the code. They leave your list and are locked.
deliver.notApproved_one: {{count, number}} string isn't approved yet. It stays in your list and keeps its current text in the code.
deliver.notApproved_other: {{count, number}} strings aren't approved yet. They stay in your list and keep their current text in the code.
deliver.unsaved: Your unsaved change to {{key}} is kept as an edit, not approved, so it isn't delivered.
deliver.done_one: Delivered {{count, number}} string. It reaches the code with the next deepl sync pull.
deliver.done_other: Delivered {{count, number}} strings. They reach the code with the next deepl sync pull.

locked.title: Delivered and locked
locked.body: Delivered on {{date}} by {{name}}. Delivered strings can't be edited.
locked.bodyNoName: Delivered on {{date}}. Delivered strings can't be edited.
locked.askAdmin: If it needs a fix, ask an admin to reopen it.
locked.reopenHint: Reopening lets reviewers correct it. The code keeps the delivered text until the next Deliver.

review.emptyOpen: Nothing open: every string is delivered.

bulk.label: Selected strings
bulk.withErrors_one: {{count, number}} has QA errors and will be skipped
bulk.withErrors_other: {{count, number}} have QA errors and will be skipped
bulk.skipped_one: {{count, number}} skipped: fix the QA errors first. It stays selected.
bulk.skipped_other: {{count, number}} skipped: fix the QA errors first. They stay selected.

errors.notFound: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

password.title: Change your password
password.forcedIntro: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
password.hint: At least {{count, number}} characters. A passphrase of a few words works well.

errors.same: Choose a password different from the current one.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create one, then connect a repository with the setup steps on its page.

create.title: New project
create.name: Name
create.idHint: Must match tms.project_id in the repository's .deepl-sync.yaml. It can't change later.
create.sourceHint: The language the strings are written in, as a code such as en.
create.targetsHint: Codes separated by commas, such as fr, es, de-CH. You can add more later.
create.invalidId: Use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores only.
create.sourceIsTarget: {{code}} is the source language, so it can't also be a target.

project.idLocked: The project ID can't change: repositories refer to it.
project.sourceLocked: The source language can't change once source strings have been uploaded.

languages.title: Languages
languages.intro: The repository decides which languages get translated: target_locales in its .deepl-sync.yaml. Adding a language here only lets you assign reviewers before the first push; a push in a new language adds it here automatically.
languages.empty: No target languages yet. Add the languages DeepL Sync translates into.
languages.removeBody: Reviewers assigned to this language lose the assignment. You can add the language again later.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: DeepL Sync and the source upload use a key to send strings to this project. A key opens this project only.
keys.empty: No keys yet. Create one to connect a repository.
keys.label: Label
keys.labelHint: Where the key will be used, such as GitHub Actions or a laptop.
keys.revokeBody: Anything using this key stops working at once. This can't be undone; create a new key if you need one.
keys.issuedBody: This is the only time Stringherd shows this key. Store it in your secret manager, then provide it as TMS_API_KEY wherever DeepL Sync runs.

setup.title: Connect a repository
setup.keyNote: Replace shp_... with one of this project's keys. Never commit the key.

create.title: Add person
create.name: Name
create.adminHint: Manages projects and people, and reviews every language.
create.passwordHint: At least {{count, number}} characters. They choose their own at first sign-in.
create.createdGenerated: Share this temporary password with them through a safe channel. It's shown only once; they choose their own at first sign-in.
create.createdChosen: Share the password you chose with them. They choose their own at first sign-in.

person.name: Name
person.selfNote: You can't change your own role or deactivate yourself.

status.title: Access
status.deactivatedBody: Can't sign in. Assignments and approvals are kept.
status.deactivateBody: They're signed out at once and can't sign in until reactivated. Their approvals stay.

languages.title: Languages
languages.adminNote: Admins review every language. Assignments only matter if this person becomes a reviewer.
languages.empty: No languages assigned. Until you assign one, they see nothing to review.
languages.noTargets: This project has no target languages yet. Add them on the project page.
languages.allAssigned: Every language of this project is already assigned.

password.title: Password
password.intro: If they forgot their password, issue a new temporary one. They're signed out everywhere and choose their own at next sign-in.
password.pending: They haven't replaced their temporary password yet.
password.resetBody: Their current password stops working and they're signed out everywhere.
password.doneBody: Share it with {{name}} through a safe channel. It's shown only once.
password.self: To change your own password, use Change password in the account menu.
